subject: general
question: India's first-ever E-Lok Adalat was organized in the State of:
solution:
The correct answer is __Chhattisgarh.__

__
 
• The first-ever E-Lok Adalat was started in Chhattisgarh during the COVID-19 period.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• The first session of the E-Lok Adalat was inaugurated by the Chief Justice of Chhattisgarh High Court, Justice P R Ramachandra Menon.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• Lok Adalats:

 
 
• The word Lok Adalat means people's Court this system is based on Gandhian principles.
 
• The Institution of Lok Adalat has been given statutory status under the legal services authorities act 1987.
 
• Lok Adalat organized for a small area shall consist of members serving or retired judicial officers and other persons of the area, it also consists of a judicial officer as the Chairman and a lawyer and social worker as members.
 
• The Lok Adalat can deal with not only the cases pending before courts but also disputes at the pre-litigation stages.
 
• The award by the Lok Adalat is binding on the parties and it has the status of the decree of a Civil court and it is not appealable.
